experiments.original_definition: Warm continuation from a formed Vortex across alpha=10^4,10^5,10^6,10^7,10^8; residual/NTS trends and five XY pressure maps
experiments.important_result: All six large-alpha solves ended with precision loss. Warm complex-field similarity remains high but elastic displacement remains about one bead radius, versus 0.04485 radius for the nominal reference. This is descriptive initialization dependence, not demonstrated converged preservation or improved mechanical accuracy.
